decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to control the board and summon powerful creatures. It includes a variety of lands to support the strategy, along with cards like Fatal Push, Leyline Binding, and Assassin's Trophy for removal. The deck also makes use of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. By combining control elements and powerful creatures, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and maintain board advantage until victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, and evasive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Mockingbird to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The deck also uses cards like Thousand-Faced Shadow and Moon-Circuit Hacker to disrupt the opponent's strategies and exploit any weaknesses in their defenses. Finally, the deck features a mix of land cards to ensure consistent mana production and to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and spells to deal damage quickly and overwhelm the opponent. It relies on efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, and spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command to push through damage and finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Cunning Coyote and Monstrous Rage to provide additional damage and pressure. Overall, the strategy is to be aggressive from the start and maintain board presence to secure a quick victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays alongside disruption spells and removal to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. Utilizing powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to control the board and close out the game swiftly. With a mix of creature aggression and disruption, this deck aims to be fast-paced and unforgiving against opponents.

The focus of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix, using various card draw and filter effects to dig through the deck efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise allows for powerful late-game plays, while cards like Fiery Impulse provide additional removal to keep the pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Brazen Borrower and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's actions, with additional cards like Picklock Prankster offering alternative win conditions. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with consistent threats and versatile gameplay.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also efficiently removing their creatures with cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. This deck also aims to apply pressure with efficient attackers like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also utilizes cards like Fear of Missing Out and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive plays while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Red Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. It focuses on dealing damage quickly using efficient creatures like Burnout Bashtronaut and Fanatical Firebrand, as well as powerful support cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Krenko, Mob Boss. The deck also includes burn spells like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to control the battlefield and apply pressure consistently, ultimately winning through sheer aggression and efficient card choices.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage through draw spells like Memory Deluge. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional value and synergy with the deck's strategy. The deck also includes a variety of lands that offer flexibility and utility in different situations. Overall, the key concept is to slow down the opponent's game plan, control the board, and win through incremental advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on maintaining a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a mix of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Duress to disrupt opponents while deploying powerful threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to quickly close out games. The deck also includes disruption in the form of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and efficient removal like Go for the Throat to keep opponents on the back foot. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless assault.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cheap spells and card draw to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, allowing them to be brought back to the battlefield for aggressive attacking. The deck includes a mix of burn spells, cantrips, and evasion creatures to support the Arclight Phoenix strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro plan that can close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck aims to be proactive and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, aiming to deal damage as quickly as possible. By utilizing efficient creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Emberheart Challenger, along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage and Screaming Nemesis provide additional ways to pump up creatures and close out the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Fear of Missing Out to disrupt your opponent's strategy while also deploying threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester to close out the game quickly. The mana base is designed to support a low curve with cards like Blood Crypt and Mutavault, while also including removal spells like Go for the Throat and Torch the Tower to control the board. The deck aims to be proactive and assert dominance early in the game while maintaining pressure throughout.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board with counterspells, removal, and card advantage while utilizing Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. The deck also aims to generate card advantage with cards like Memory Deluge and Stock Up, while also having ways to deal with threats efficiently through cards like Portable Hole and Supreme Verdict. The deck has a variety of win conditions, including Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, to secure victory after stabilizing the board.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and overwhelm the opponent with large, powerful green creatures. Cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic help generate extra mana, while cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns provide strong threats on the battlefield. The goal is to establish a board presence early on and maintain pressure on the opponent, utilizing cards like Storm the Festival to refill your hand with even more threats. The deck's focus on green devotion allows for explosive plays and fast victories.
